title: C link: estimate_density (R-02a-117/135) + host CTest consuming ccp16_load_balance estimate_density vectors
description: Smallest slice of b7z9.29 (decompose-first). rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs:122-137 estimate_density is implemented+tested; python mirror; C has NO estimator — only the report API lichen_lora_l2_set_density (lora_l2_tx.c:569-578, driven by a test only). Port the formula to C in lichen/subsys/lichen/link (rf_health.c or a new density_estimate.{c,h}) mirroring rust exactly, and consume test/vectors/ccp16_load_balance.json estimate_density vectors (:626-724, currently zero consumers) in a host CTest (extend lichen/tests/rf_health or new tests/rf_density). Parent residue stays: rolling-window machinery (R-02a-133), BusyPercent TX-time sampler (R-02a-131), MitigateInterference consolidation (R-02a-142).
